top_signals.title: DNV Backs Blue Ammonia FPSO Concept from BW Offshore and McDermott
top_signals.summary: BW Offshore's blue ammonia floating production, storage and offloading (FPSO) concept, jointly developed with McDermott, has received Approval in Principle (AiP) from DNV, advancing the proposed offshore low-carbon ammonia production solution…
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
